recommendation: Keep this narrow source fix. It preserves the FHIR-3839 encounter capability and aligns the current search surface with later OO decisions; no additional core source work is needed for this seed unless a future work group decision changes DiagnosticReport.encounter semantics again.
issue_request: FHIR-3839 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 OO change request asking core DiagnosticReport to add an encounter reference. The final motion approved a 0..1 Reference(Encounter) linked to the encounter where the order was created.
initial_application: Commit 42b3e0ef629223d03f49481d856a41d1f7918509 explicitly applied #3839 by adding DiagnosticReport.encounter as 0..1 Reference(Encounter) and creating the encounter search parameter with the original order-made description. Later source migrations preserved the element and generated search-parameter source.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini. Later applied OO decisions changed how the encounter element should be understood in the current build: FHIR-12797 aligned DiagnosticReport with the event pattern, FHIR-17662 retained the element as .encounter, FHIR-48767 clarified that DiagnosticReport.encounter typically represents the encounter where reported data or specimens were obtained/acquired and that ServiceRequest.encounter supplies order association through DiagnosticReport.basedOn, and FHIR-51687 changed the requirements text from request to report.
reconciliation: Updated source/diagnosticreport/bundle-DiagnosticReport-search-params.xml so DiagnosticReport-encounter says "Encounter associated with the DiagnosticReport" instead of the stale "The Encounter when the order was made" wording. The search code, expression, type, and the DiagnosticReport.encounter element itself were unchanged.
source_changes: source/diagnosticreport/bundle-DiagnosticReport-search-params.xml: changed DiagnosticReport-encounter description from order-made wording to "Encounter associated with the DiagnosticReport".

related_jiras.note: Harmonized DiagnosticReport to the event pattern after the original DSTU1 encounter addition.
Changed applicable OO .context elements back to .encounter and is already represented on the combined branch.
Clarified current DiagnosticReport.encounter semantics and ServiceRequest.encounter order association.
Corrected DiagnosticReport.encounter requirements to link the report, not the request, to the encounter context.
